questions.title: Array Sum Calculator
questions.description: Write a Java program that creates an array of 5 integers {10, 20, 30, 40, 50} and calculates their sum using a for loop.
constraints: Use a for loop to calculate sum

questions.title: Find Maximum
questions.description: Write a Java program that finds the maximum value in an array {45, 12, 78, 34, 56, 89, 23}. Use a loop to compare elements.
constraints: Do not use built-in max functions
Use a loop to find maximum
Print the maximum value and its index
hints: Compare each element with current max

questions.title: Array Reversal
questions.description: Write a Java program that reverses an array {1, 2, 3, 4, 5} in-place (without creating a new array). Print the array before and after reversal.
constraints: Do not create a new array
hints: Use two pointers: start and end
Swap elements at start and end

questions.title: 2D Array Sum
questions.description: Write a Java program that creates a 3x3 matrix and calculates the sum of all elements and the sum of the diagonal elements. Use: {{1,2,3}, {4,5,6}, {7,8,9}}.
constraints: Calculate total sum using nested loops

questions.title: Bubble Sort Implementation
questions.description: Write a Java program that sorts the array {64, 34, 25, 12, 22, 11, 90} using the bubble sort algorithm. Print the array after each pass to show the sorting progress.
constraints: Show array after each complete pass
hints: Outer loop: n-1 passes, Inner loop: comparisons
